text: Marla City splits down the middle again: Dusk waits alone at the intake valve, Flint demands Vale show up there with hard water-pressure numbers, and Reed instead pulls Vale off to the orchards to search for Elias in person — leaving both Dusk and Flint stood up. Elias is still missing, and everyone's got a different theory: Dusk blames the valve, Reed and Vale think it's something simpler out in the orchards. On top of that, Lumen keeps poking at Vale, accusing her of hiding behind her datapad instead of feeling things, while Reed's crop-cutting plan — pick the best crops, drop the rest — is still hanging out there unresolved.
